court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Santa Cruz
case_search_note: 'Case Search' portal linked from the Criminal Division page (same portal used for online payments). Online criminal payment only if you already pled guilty and have a payment plan.

sources.title: SCZ Superior Court — Locations & Contact Info

courthouses.name: Santa Cruz Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Clerk's office Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; phones answered Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: All criminal cases (felonies, misdemeanors, some infractions) are filed only here; criminal clerk Room 120. Also traffic. Criminal email criminalinfo@santacruzcourt.org. Check the calendar posted outside Room 120 for your department.
courthouses.todo: Court does not publish criminal department numbers on the pages loaded

courthouses.name: Watsonville Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Clerk's office (Room 300): Tue–Thu 8:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m. and 1:30–3:00 p.m.; closed Mon & Fri (Criminal Division page). Locations page says clerk's offices open 8am–3pm — confirm.
courthouses.note: Traffic filings/in-person services; accepts traffic fine payments and existing criminal payment plans. Criminal cases are NOT filed here (Santa Cruz only).

public_defenders.name: Santa Cruz County Office of the Public Defender — Santa Cruz
Santa Cruz County Office of the Public Defender — Watsonville
public_defenders.todo: Same phone for both offices; hours not listed

legal_aid.name: Santa Cruz County Public Defender — Clean Slate Team
legal_aid.serves: People arrested or convicted in Santa Cruz County, on probation there, or registering there
legal_aid.what: Record clearance: sealing arrest records, dismissing/expunging convictions, reducing felonies to misdemeanors, Certificate of Rehabilitation. Email an application; team responds within several weeks.

probation.name: Santa Cruz County Probation — Adult Probation / Administrative Offices
probation.hours: Weekdays 8 a.m.–5 p.m., closed 12–1 p.m. (general office hours)
probation.note: Mailing: P.O. Box 1812, Santa Cruz, CA 95061-1812. Pretrial notifications email PRBPretrialNotification@Santacruzcounty.us.

probation.name: Santa Cruz County Probation — Watsonville (Adult & Juvenile)

programs.name: Probation Pretrial Services
programs.summary: Uses actuarial assessments to release arrested/charged people with the least restrictive monitoring, and monitors those the court finds eligible to stay in the community. County warns of a pretrial/electronic-monitoring scam.
programs.todo: No pretrial phone/address published; only email PRBPretrialNotification@Santacruzcounty.us

programs.name: Court Self-Help Center
programs.summary: Court self-help services; contact by email.
programs.todo: Self-help location, phone and hours not captured; email selfhelp.information@santacruzcourt.org

programs.name: Behavioral Health Court (BHC)
programs.summary: Post-adjudication court with County Behavioral Health for people with severe mental illness and co-occurring substance use disorders.

programs.name: Intensive Support Court (ISC)
programs.summary: Pre-adjudication program for people granted mental health diversion who have mental health and/or substance use issues.

programs.name: Veteran Court (VC)
programs.summary: Alternative sentencing connecting veterans with service-related mental health or substance use issues to treatment.

jails.name: Santa Cruz County Main Jail
jails.phone_note: Main Jail & Blaine visit scheduling (831) 454-7800, Mon–Thu 8:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.; weekend non-contact visits only. Cash bail (cash or cashier's check payable to Santa Cruz County Superior Court, with ID) accepted here.
jails.todo: Sheriff pages do not state who the Main Jail houses. Commissary: Aramark CORE trust deposits: lobby kiosks (Main Jail; Rountree pending), touchpayonline.com, or 1-866-232-1899; money orders by mail c/o Sheriff Fiscal, 259 Water St. court_ids: all criminal cases are filed in Santa Cruz (court) and FAQ says the Corrections Bureau transports or video-links people to court — specific courthouse not stated by the sheriff.

jails.name: Blaine Street Women's Facility
jails.phone_note: Visit scheduling via (831) 454-7800. Monthly family contact visits available for people with minor children.
jails.todo: 'Women's' comes from the Sheriff homepage wording 'Blaine Street Women's Facility'; facility page itself doesn't say. court_ids: only criminal courthouse in county (criminal filed only in Santa Cruz).

jails.name: Rehabilitation and Reentry Facility
jails.phone_note: Overseen by the Rountree Commander; same visit-scheduling line as Rountree. Monthly family contact visits for people with minor children.

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' — look up a bail agent's license status. Santa Cruz Sheriff FAQ: cash bail accepted at the Main Jail (259 Water St., Santa Cruz) in cash or cashier's check payable to Santa Cruz County Superior Court; bring valid DL, ID card or passport. Inmate lookup is the Sheriff's 'Jail Inmate Locator' link (http, not https).
